demonic-consultation.title: Demonic Consultation Printings: Ice Age, Art & Foils | ManaScout
demonic-consultation.description: Compare Demonic Consultation's Ice Age original with kozyndan Secret Lair, Future Sight-frame and poster editions, including collector numbers and halo foil.
demonic-consultation.opening: Demonic Consultation debuted in Ice Age in June 1995. ICE #121 is an uncommon illustrated by Rob Alexander and is nonfoil only. The number is a catalogue identifier rather than a printed modern collector-number line on the original card.

the-theorist-jace-beleren.title: The Theorist, Jace Beleren Printings, Showcase & Foils | ManaScout
the-theorist-jace-beleren.description: Identify The Theorist FRA #43, braintwister #363, Japan Showcase and fracture foil, plus the later Secret Lair Bundle promo and its distinct artwork.
the-theorist-jace-beleren.opening: The Theorist, Jace Beleren first appeared in Reality Fracture (FRA), 2 October 2026. The original record is FRA #43, at mythic rare, illustrated by Ekaterina Burmak. Original finish availability: nonfoil, traditional foil.

smaug-wicked-worm.title: Smaug, Wicked Worm Printings, Book Cover Art & Surge Foil | ManaScout
smaug-wicked-worm.description: Compare Smaug, Wicked Worm HOB #164, Tyler Jacobson’s book-cover #245 and surge foil #281. Identify the exact card without confusing other Smaug designs.
smaug-wicked-worm.opening: Smaug, Wicked Worm first appeared in The Hobbit (HOB), 14 August 2026. The original record is HOB #164, at rare, illustrated by Antonio José Manzanedo. Original finish availability: nonfoil, traditional foil.

mana-drain.title: Mana Drain Printings: Legends, Artwork & Foils | ManaScout
mana-drain.description: Compare Mana Drain from Legends #65 to Judge, Iconic Masters, extended art, borderless, etched and textured Breaking News versions, with artists and numbers.
mana-drain.opening: Mana Drain first appeared in Legends in June 1994. LEG #65 is an uncommon illustrated by Mark Tedin and is nonfoil only. Its catalogue number is not a modern collector-number line printed on the original card.

arcane-signet.title: Arcane Signet First Printing & MTG Versions | ManaScout
arcane-signet.description: Arcane Signet debuted in 2019's Throne of Eldraine Brawl decks. Identify ELD #331 and compare later artwork, editions and foil finishes.
arcane-signet.opening: Arcane Signet was first printed in the Throne of Eldraine Brawl decks, released on 4 October 2019. The original ELD #331 is a nonfoil-only common illustrated by Dan Murayama Scott, not a regular Draft Booster inclusion. Compare later artwork, borderless versions and foil finishes separately from that original printing.

swan-song.title: Swan Song Printings, Original Art & Foil Guide | ManaScout
swan-song.description: Compare Swan Song’s Theros original with Commander reprints and Secret Lair artwork. Identify artists, collector numbers and legitimate foil choices.
swan-song.opening: Swan Song first appeared in Theros (THS), 27 September 2013. The original is THS #65, at rare, illustrated by Peter Mohrbacher. Available original finishes: Nonfoil, traditional foil.

thoughtseize.title: Thoughtseize Printings, Artwork & Versions | ManaScout
thoughtseize.description: Identify Thoughtseize’s Lorwyn original, Theros art, Invocation, retro frame, borderless and Junji Ito editions, plus Breaking News textured foil.
thoughtseize.opening: Thoughtseize first appeared in Lorwyn (LRW), 12 October 2007. The original is LRW #145, at rare, illustrated by Aleksi Briclot. Available original finishes: Nonfoil, traditional foil.

senseis-divining-top.title: Sensei’s Divining Top Printings, Foils & Legality | ManaScout
senseis-divining-top.description: Trace Sensei’s Divining Top from Champions of Kamigawa uncommon to Eternal Masters art and Double Masters borderless and etched editions, with legality context.
senseis-divining-top.opening: Sensei's Divining Top first appeared in Champions of Kamigawa (CHK), 1 October 2004. The original is CHK #268, at uncommon, illustrated by Michael Sutfin. Available original finishes: Nonfoil, traditional foil.

deflecting-swat.title: Deflecting Swat MTG — Board Wipes & Printings | ManaScout
deflecting-swat.description: Deflecting Swat redirects targets; it does not counter spells. Learn when a board wipe can be redirected, then compare MTG artwork, printings and finishes.
deflecting-swat.opening: Deflecting Swat changes targets; it does not counter spells or abilities. It cannot redirect an untargeted board wipe. Its first printing is Commander 2020 (C20) #50, a nonfoil-only rare illustrated by Izzy, included in the Arcane Maelstrom deck associated with Kalamax, the Stormsire. The targeted-versus-untargeted distinction is explained below.

esper-sentinel.title: Esper Sentinel MTG — Sketch, Retro & Foil Printings | ManaScout
esper-sentinel.description: Identify Esper Sentinel MH2 #12, compare sketch #328 with retro and Secret Lair art, and choose an exact edition by collector number and finish.
esper-sentinel.opening: Esper Sentinel first appeared in Modern Horizons 2 on 18 June 2021. The standard rare is MH2 #12, illustrated by Eric Deschamps. The same release included sketch showcase #328; both have nonfoil and traditional foil options. Compare the standard and sketch artwork before choosing between later retro and Secret Lair versions.

counterspell.title: Counterspell Printings: Alpha, Artwork & Early Foils | ManaScout
counterspell.description: Compare Counterspell from Alpha #54 to early foils, Judge art, Mystical Archive and Modern Horizons 2, with artists, collector numbers and finish comparisons.
counterspell.opening: Counterspell debuted in Limited Edition Alpha in August 1993. The original uncommon is LEA #54, illustrated by Mark Poole and available only in nonfoil. The number is a modern catalogue reference, not a collector-number line printed on the Alpha card.

smothering-tithe.title: Smothering Tithe Printings: Originals, Art & Foils | ManaScout
smothering-tithe.description: Compare Smothering Tithe from Ravnica Allegiance #22 to borderless, etched and anime confetti foil versions, with artists, set codes and collector numbers.
smothering-tithe.opening: Smothering Tithe debuted in Ravnica Allegiance on 25 January 2019. The original rare is RNA #22, illustrated by Mark Behm, in nonfoil and traditional foil.

bloodline-recollector.title: Bloodline Recollector MTG — Serialized 500 & Printings | ManaScout
bloodline-recollector.description: Identify Bloodline Recollector FRA #49 and compare extended art, promos and Mark Poole’s #402 headliner. Only the serialized treatment is limited to 500 copies.
bloodline-recollector.opening: Bloodline Recollector was first printed in Reality Fracture on 2 October 2026. The original FRA #49 is a mythic rare illustrated by Cynthia Sheppard, available in nonfoil and traditional foil. The 500-copy limit belongs to serialized #402, not normal Bloodline Recollector cards.

mox-diamond.title: Mox Diamond Printings, Stronghold & From the Vault Foil | ManaScout
mox-diamond.description: Compare Mox Diamond’s Stronghold #138 debut with From the Vault: Relics #10: original art, foil differences, Reserved List context and collector choices.
mox-diamond.opening: Mox Diamond first appeared in Stronghold (STH), 2 March 1998. The original record is STH #138, at rare, illustrated by Dan Frazier. Original finish availability: nonfoil only.

dockside-extortionist.title: Dockside Extortionist Printings, Commander Ban & Art | ManaScout
dockside-extortionist.description: Trace Dockside Extortionist from Commander 2019 #24 through Double Masters borderless and etched versions, The List and Avatar art, with dated ban status.
dockside-extortionist.opening: Dockside Extortionist first appeared in Commander 2019 (C19), 23 August 2019. The original record is C19 #24, at rare, illustrated by Forrest Imel. Original finish availability: nonfoil only.

urzas-saga.title: Urza's Saga Printings: Sketch, Textless & Halo Foil | ManaScout
urzas-saga.description: Compare Urza's Saga's MH2 original and sketch, Store Championship textless art and Secret Lair halo foil, with verified artists, numbers and finishes.
urzas-saga.opening: The card Urza's Saga debuted in Modern Horizons 2 on 18 June 2021. MH2 #259 is a rare illustrated by Titus Lunter, available in nonfoil and traditional foil. It is not a card first printed in the older expansion with the same name.

cavern-of-souls.title: Cavern of Souls Printings, Borderless Art & Neon Foils | ManaScout
cavern-of-souls.description: Compare Cavern of Souls’ Avacyn Restored debut, Masters reprints, borderless art, foil-etched versions, LOTR surge foil and Cosmium neon-ink treatment.

mana-crypt.title: Mana Crypt MTG — First Printing, Art & Neon Foils | ManaScout
mana-crypt.description: Identify Mana Crypt’s book-promo first printing and compare later artwork, Invention and neon foil records. Keep edition, suffix and current legality distinct.
mana-crypt.opening: Mana Crypt first appeared in HarperPrism Book Promos (PHPR), 1995 (catalogue date: 1 May). The original record is PHPR #5, at rare, illustrated by Mark Tedin. Original finish availability: nonfoil only. Compare the original book promo with later artwork and neon treatment records; suffixes and finish categories distinguish physical versions.

the-great-henge.title: The Great Henge Printings: Originals, Party Tree & Foils | ManaScout
the-great-henge.description: Compare The Great Henge's Eldraine original, extended art, etched reprint and The Party Tree editions, including surge foil, serialized copies and artists.
the-great-henge.opening: The Great Henge debuted in Throne of Eldraine on 4 October 2019. ELD #161 is a mythic rare illustrated by Adam Paquette, available in nonfoil and traditional foil. Extended-art #370 keeps Paquette's artwork.

necropotence.title: Necropotence Printings: Ice Age, Artwork & Foils | ManaScout
necropotence.description: Compare Necropotence's Ice Age original with Masters reprints, storybook and anime Enchanting Tales, including artists, collector numbers and confetti foil.

fierce-guardianship.title: Fierce Guardianship MTG — Original & Foil Printings | ManaScout
fierce-guardianship.description: Identify Fierce Guardianship’s Commander 2020 original and compare later artwork and foil editions. Check set, collector number and available finish.

Compare the Commander original with later artwork and finish records below; do not infer a foil from a missing price field.

lightning-greaves.title: Lightning Greaves Printings: Mirrodin, Art & Foils | ManaScout

black-lotus.title: Black Lotus MTG — Original Art, Editions & Reprints | ManaScout
black-lotus.description: Identify Black Lotus’s Alpha original and compare Beta, Unlimited and Collector’s Edition records. Separate original art, later reproductions and play eligibility.

mystic-remora.title: Mystic Remora MTG — Original Art, Retro & Foil Versions | ManaScout
mystic-remora.description: Identify Mystic Remora’s Ice Age #87 original and compare Secret Lair, retro-frame and later foil artwork. Inspect exact sets, artists and finishes.

It is the historical starting point; a retro-frame Dominaria Remastered copy is a later printing with different art. Compare the original image with later retro-frame and foil records; a retro frame alone does not identify an Ice Age original.

cyclonic-rift.title: Cyclonic Rift MTG — First Printing, Art & Foils | ManaScout

Compare that original with later retro, etched and serialized records; identify the treatment before choosing a finish.

mana-vault.title: Mana Vault Printings: Alpha, Invention & Foil Art | ManaScout

Alpha cards do not have a printed modern collector-number line, so #259 is a catalogue reference rather than a marking to expect on the card.

lotus-petal.title: Lotus Petal Printings, First Edition & Foil Guide | ManaScout
lotus-petal.description: Explore Lotus Petal’s Tempest common, From the Vault foil, Kaladesh Invention, anniversary etched promo and Mystery Booster 2 reprint.
lotus-petal.opening: Lotus Petal first appeared in Tempest (TMP), 14 October 1997. The original is TMP #294, at common, illustrated by April Lee. Available original finishes: Nonfoil only.

rhystic-study.title: Rhystic Study MTG Printings, Art & Foils | ManaScout
rhystic-study.description: Find Rhystic Study's first printing, Prophecy PCY #45 from 2000. Compare original art, later versions and foil finishes by exact set and collector number.
rhystic-study.opening: Rhystic Study was first printed in Prophecy on 5 June 2000. The original PCY #45 is a common illustrated by Terese Nielsen, available in nonfoil and traditional foil. Use the printing shortlist and explorer to compare that original artwork with later versions and finishes.

doubling-season.title: Doubling Season MTG — Original Art & Foil Printings | ManaScout
doubling-season.description: Identify Doubling Season’s Ravnica original and compare later artwork, reprints and foil treatments. Use exact edition, artist and collector-number records.
doubling-season.opening: Doubling Season first appeared in Ravnica: City of Guilds (RAV), 7 October 2005. The original record is RAV #158, at rare, illustrated by Wayne Reynolds. Original finish availability: nonfoil, traditional foil. Compare the original with later artwork and foil treatment records; a reprint can change the painting as well as the frame.

lightning-bolt.title: Lightning Bolt MTG — Alpha Original & Artwork Versions | ManaScout
lightning-bolt.description: Identify Lightning Bolt’s Alpha #161 original and compare later art, reprints and Mystical Archive finishes. Separate original editions from later versions.
lightning-bolt.opening: Lightning Bolt first appeared in Limited Edition Alpha (LEA), 5 August 1993. The original record is LEA #161, at common, illustrated by Christopher Rush. Original finish availability: nonfoil only. Compare the Alpha original with later artwork and reprints; the same spell can have a different artist, frame and finish.

mystic-sanctuary.title: Mystic Sanctuary Printings, Secret Lair & Retro Foils | ManaScout
mystic-sanctuary.description: Compare Mystic Sanctuary’s Eldraine #247 original, TSR #408 retro frame, later nonfoil reprints and Amélie Fléchais’s foil-only Dandân version #2143.
mystic-sanctuary.opening: Mystic Sanctuary first appeared in Throne of Eldraine (ELD), 4 October 2019. The original record is ELD #247, at common, illustrated by Randy Vargas. Original finish availability: nonfoil, traditional foil.

gaeas-cradle.title: Gaea’s Cradle MTG — Original Printing & Judge Foil | ManaScout
gaeas-cradle.description: Identify Gaea’s Cradle USG #321 and distinguish the original from its Judge foil. Compare artist, set and collector number without conflating editions.
gaeas-cradle.opening: Gaea's Cradle first appeared in Urza’s Saga (USG), 12 October 1998. The original record is USG #321, at rare, illustrated by Mark Zug. Original finish availability: nonfoil only. Compare the original nonfoil with the separately identified Judge foil; a foil listing is not an original Urza’s Saga finish.

mr-spock-science-officer.title: Mr. Spock, Science Officer MTG — Printings & Art | ManaScout
mr-spock-science-officer.description: Explore Mr. Spock, Science Officer as an MTG card. Compare Star Trek TRK #74 with alternative artwork, collector numbers and available foil finishes.
mr-spock-science-officer.opening: Mr. Spock, Science Officer is an MTG card from Star Trek (TRK), released on 13 November 2026. The first standard-frame printing is TRK #74, a mythic rare illustrated by Colin Boyer, with nonfoil and traditional foil versions. Compare its artwork, collector number and finish with the scene, showcase and headliner records below.

sheoldred-the-apocalypse.title: Sheoldred, the Apocalypse MTG — Printings, Foils & Art | ManaScout
sheoldred-the-apocalypse.description: Compare Sheoldred’s original DMU #107, showcase and textured foils, concept art and SDS #11 Stardates reprint. Identify exact artists, numbers and finishes.
sheoldred-the-apocalypse.opening: Sheoldred, the Apocalypse was first printed in Dominaria United on 9 September 2022. The original DMU #107 is a mythic rare illustrated by Chris Rahn, available in nonfoil and traditional foil. Compare DMU showcase and textured records separately from the later SDS #11 Stardates reprint.

skullclamp.title: Skullclamp Printings, Original Art & Foil Guide | ManaScout
skullclamp.description: Identify Skullclamp’s Darksteel debut, original foil, From the Vault edition, Warhammer surge foil and Secret Lair art, with exact collector records.
skullclamp.opening: Skullclamp first appeared in Darksteel (DST), 6 February 2004. The original is DST #140, at uncommon, illustrated by Luca Zontini. Available original finishes: Nonfoil, traditional foil.

jeweled-lotus.title: Jeweled Lotus MTG — Original, Textured & Etched Foils | ManaScout
jeweled-lotus.description: Identify Jeweled Lotus CMR #319 and compare extended art, etched and textured Commander Masters editions. Check printing, artist and finish separately.
jeweled-lotus.opening: Jeweled Lotus first appeared in Commander Legends (CMR), 20 November 2020. The original is CMR #319, at mythic, illustrated by Alayna Danner. Available original finishes: Nonfoil, traditional foil. Compare the original with the later etched and textured records below; those are different physical finishes, not interchangeable foil labels.

chrome-mox.title: Chrome Mox Printings: Mirrodin, Inventions & Foils | ManaScout
chrome-mox.description: Compare Chrome Mox originals, Grand Prix art, Kaladesh Inventions and first-place foil editions, with verified artists, collector numbers and finish choices.
chrome-mox.opening: Chrome Mox debuted in Mirrodin in October 2003. MRD #152 is a rare illustrated by Donato Giancola and is available in nonfoil and traditional foil.

worldly-tutor.title: Worldly Tutor Printings, Original Art & Foil Guide | ManaScout
worldly-tutor.description: Trace Worldly Tutor from Mirage and Sixth Edition to Commander Collection: Green and Dominaria Remastered, comparing art, retro frames and real foils.
worldly-tutor.opening: Worldly Tutor first appeared in Mirage (MIR), 8 October 1996. The original is MIR #255, at uncommon, illustrated by David O’Connor. Available original finishes: Nonfoil only.

ancient-tomb.title: Ancient Tomb First Printing, Expeditions & Foil Versions | ManaScout
ancient-tomb.description: Trace Ancient Tomb from Tempest #315 through From the Vault, Expeditions, Ultimate Masters and LOTR surge foil. Compare artists, frames and finishes.
ancient-tomb.opening: Ancient Tomb first appeared in Tempest (TMP), 14 October 1997. The original record is TMP #315, at uncommon, illustrated by Colin MacNeil. Original finish availability: nonfoil only.

mystical-tutor.title: Mystical Tutor Printings, Artwork & Versions | ManaScout
mystical-tutor.description: Compare Mystical Tutor’s Mirage original with boxed foils, Jace art, Secret Lair, retro and borderless reprints. Check collector numbers and real finishes.
mystical-tutor.opening: Mystical Tutor first appeared in Mirage (MIR), 8 October 1996. The original is MIR #80, at uncommon, illustrated by David O’Connor. Available original finishes: Nonfoil only.

captain-james-t-kirk.title: Captain James T. Kirk MTG — Signed Card, Printings & Art | ManaScout
captain-james-t-kirk.description: Identify Captain James T. Kirk TRK #142 and compare showcase art, surge foil and the hand-signed #1701 headliner. Separate artist, autograph and finish.
captain-james-t-kirk.opening: Captain James T. Kirk was first printed in Star Trek on 13 November 2026. Compare regular and showcase art before treating the signed #1701 headliner as a separate collector choice.

demonic-tutor.title: Demonic Tutor MTG — Alpha Original & Alternate Art | ManaScout
demonic-tutor.description: Identify Demonic Tutor’s Alpha #104 original and compare later artwork, borderless and etched editions. Match the set before relying on a collector number.
demonic-tutor.opening: Demonic Tutor debuted in Limited Edition Alpha in August 1993. The original uncommon is LEA #104, illustrated by Douglas Shuler, and is nonfoil only. Beta and several later early editions use catalogue number 105 instead; the set code is essential when identifying an original. Compare the Alpha original with later alternate art and etched records; the set code matters as much as the number.

the-one-ring.title: The One Ring MTG — Versions, Foils & Unique 001/001 | ManaScout
the-one-ring.description: Identify The One Ring’s standard, scene and scroll versions; distinguish surge foil, serialized Sol Ring cards and the unique 001/001 One Ring headliner.
the-one-ring.opening: The One Ring debuted in The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth, released on 23 June 2023. The original standard printing is LTR #246, a mythic rare illustrated by Veli Nystrom, available in nonfoil and traditional foil. Compare the original with scene, scroll and special-finish records below; the unique 001/001 headliner is not every foil One Ring.

path-to-exile.title: Path to Exile MTG — Original Printing & Artwork | ManaScout

teferis-protection.title: Teferi’s Protection Printings, Secret Lairs & Premium Foils | ManaScout
teferis-protection.description: Compare Teferi’s Protection C17 #8 with Judge foil, Secret Lair art, Mystical Archive editions and Double Masters borderless and etched treatments.
teferis-protection.opening: Teferi's Protection first appeared in Commander 2017 (C17), 25 August 2017. The original record is C17 #8, at rare, illustrated by Chase Stone. Original finish availability: nonfoil only.

swords-to-plowshares.title: Swords to Plowshares Printings, Original Art & Foils | ManaScout
swords-to-plowshares.description: Explore Swords to Plowshares from Alpha #40 through classic art, Judge and Masters editions, Mystical Archive etched foil and Fallout surge printing.
swords-to-plowshares.opening: Swords to Plowshares first appeared in Limited Edition Alpha (LEA), 5 August 1993. The original record is LEA #40, at uncommon, illustrated by Jeff A. Menges. Original finish availability: nonfoil only.

jeskas-will.title: Jeska’s Will Printings, Extended Art & Premium Versions | ManaScout

captain-jean-luc-picard.title: Captain Jean-Luc Picard MTG Printings & Foils | ManaScout
captain-jean-luc-picard.description: Compare Captain Jean-Luc Picard’s first TRK #7 printing, LCARS art, surge foil #497 and signed headliner #1701D, with artists and collector numbers.
captain-jean-luc-picard.opening: Captain Jean-Luc Picard’s first release is Star Trek (TRK), scheduled for global tabletop release on 13 November 2026. The original standard-frame record is TRK #7, a mythic rare illustrated by Anna Pavleeva, with nonfoil and traditional foil versions.

edgar-markov.title: Edgar Markov Printings, First Edition & Foil Guide | ManaScout
edgar-markov.description: Compare Edgar Markov’s foil-only Commander 2017 debut, Judge art, Innistrad Remastered fang and retro frames, and serialized movie-poster edition.
edgar-markov.opening: Edgar Markov first appeared in Commander 2017 (C17), 25 August 2017. The original is C17 #36, at mythic, illustrated by Volkan Baga. Available original finishes: Traditional foil only.

enlightened-tutor.title: Enlightened Tutor Printings, Original Art & Foil Guide | ManaScout
enlightened-tutor.description: Compare Enlightened Tutor’s Mirage original, Arena and Judge foils, Eternal Masters art and Dominaria Remastered retro and borderless editions.
enlightened-tutor.opening: Enlightened Tutor first appeared in Mirage (MIR), 8 October 1996. The original is MIR #14, at uncommon, illustrated by Dan Frazier. Available original finishes: Nonfoil only.

brainstorm.title: Brainstorm Printings, Artwork & Versions | ManaScout
brainstorm.description: Compare Brainstorm’s Ice Age original, Masques foil, Mark Poole art and Mystical Archive versions. Identify exact artists, collector numbers and finishes.
brainstorm.opening: Brainstorm first appeared in Ice Age (ICE), 3 June 1995. The original is ICE #61, at common, illustrated by Christopher Rush. Available original finishes: Nonfoil only.

force-of-will.title: Force of Will MTG — Alliances Original & Foil Art | ManaScout
force-of-will.description: Identify Force of Will’s Alliances original and compare later artwork and foil printings. Match artists, set codes and collector numbers before selecting.
force-of-will.opening: Force of Will debuted in Alliances in June 1996. ALL #28 is an uncommon illustrated by Terese Nielsen, available only in nonfoil. The number is a catalogue identifier: the original card predates printed modern collector-number lines. Compare the Alliances original with the later artwork and foil records below; choose the edition before choosing a reflective surface.

mox-opal.title: Mox Opal MTG — Original, Judge Foil & Invention | ManaScout
mox-opal.description: Identify Mox Opal SOM #179 and compare Masters artwork, Judge foil and Kaladesh Invention editions. Inspect each set, collector number and available finish.
mox-opal.opening: Mox Opal first appeared in Scars of Mirrodin (SOM), 1 October 2010. The original is SOM #179, at mythic, illustrated by Volkan Baga. Available original finishes: Nonfoil, traditional foil. Compare the Scars original with the Judge foil and Invention records below; these are separate collector editions, not just a finish toggle.

command-tower.title: Command Tower Printings, First Edition & Foil Guide | ManaScout
command-tower.description: Compare Command Tower’s 2011 original with Arsenal foil, extended art, Commander Masters borderless art and later setting-specific reprints.
command-tower.opening: Command Tower first appeared in Commander 2011 (CMD), 17 June 2011. The original is CMD #269, at common, illustrated by Ryan Yee. Available original finishes: Nonfoil only.

smaug-the-magnificent.title: Smaug the Magnificent MTG — Gleaming Gold & Printings | ManaScout
smaug-the-magnificent.description: Compare Smaug the Magnificent HOB #110, Dragon hoard art and gleaming gold #249. Identify the approximately 500-copy headliner separately from ordinary foils.
smaug-the-magnificent.opening: Smaug the Magnificent was first printed in The Hobbit on 14 August 2026. The original HOB #110 is a mythic rare illustrated by Francisco Miyara, available in nonfoil and traditional foil. The approximately 500-copy gleaming gold #249 is a separate headliner treatment, not the total number of Smaug cards.

living-death.title: Living Death Printings, Original Art & Foil Guide | ManaScout
living-death.description: Trace Living Death from Tempest #142 to Masters 25 and Warhammer surge foil. Compare exact artworks, physical finishes and its symmetrical graveyard rules.
living-death.opening: Living Death first appeared in Tempest (TMP), 14 October 1997. The original is TMP #142, at rare, illustrated by Charles Gillespie. Available original finishes: Nonfoil only.

vampiric-tutor.title: Vampiric Tutor Printings: Visions, Artwork & Foils | ManaScout
vampiric-tutor.description: Compare Vampiric Tutor's Visions original with Judge, extended-art, retro, borderless and Mystical Archive versions, with artists, numbers and foil options.
vampiric-tutor.opening: Vampiric Tutor debuted in Visions in February 1997. VIS #72 is a rare illustrated by Gary Leach and is nonfoil only. Its catalogue identifier predates printed modern collector-number lines.

sol-ring.title: Sol Ring First Printing & MTG Versions | ManaScout
sol-ring.description: Sol Ring first appeared in Alpha in 1993. Identify the original, compare later artwork and foil versions, then inspect exact editions by set and number.
sol-ring.opening: Sol Ring was first printed in Limited Edition Alpha in August 1993. The original uncommon features Mark Tedin's artwork and is catalogued as LEA #269. It is nonfoil; that catalogue number is a database identifier, not a number printed on the Alpha card. Compare later artwork and foil versions in the explorer.

birds-of-paradise.title: Birds of Paradise Printings: Original Art, Foils & Versions | ManaScout
birds-of-paradise.description: Compare Birds of Paradise’s Alpha debut, Seventh Edition foil, Ravnica art, Buy-a-Box promo and Dominaria Remastered frames by artist and collector number.
birds-of-paradise.opening: Birds of Paradise first appeared in Limited Edition Alpha (LEA), 5 August 1993. The original record is LEA #186, at rare, illustrated by Mark Poole. Original finish availability: nonfoil only.

jace-the-mind-sculptor.title: Jace, the Mind Sculptor Printings, Art & Foils | ManaScout
jace-the-mind-sculptor.description: Compare Jace’s Worldwake #31 original, Jason Chan Masters versions, Mythic Edition, Secret Lair art and Bloomburrow raised foils by exact collector number.
jace-the-mind-sculptor.opening: Jace, the Mind Sculptor first appeared in Worldwake (WWK), 5 February 2010. The original record is WWK #31, at mythic rare, illustrated by Jason Chan. Original finish availability: nonfoil, traditional foil.
